decision.reason: [ev-e5af8a1b5781] is a one-line changelog entry that says only that Loki 3.0.0 adds "support for case-insensitive logql functions" and links to PR 10733. It does not say which LogQL functions are affected. It also does not say what "case-insensitive" means here: function names accepted in any case, or case-insensitive matching of values. It does not say whether queries that used to fail or behave differently now behave differently. Without that, applicability (which environments or queries are exposed) can't be written. The PR description or the LogQL docs for this change are needed.
